summary: Route Playwright only to browser faults and bound inspections with step-specific timeout evidence.
features: Restrict Playwright selection to visible DOM, layout, rendering, console, and browser-network symptoms.
Report the active browser inspection step together with bounded Chromium, process, and startup-log evidence on timeout.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
fixes: Prevent backend approval and API investigations from unnecessarily opening Playwright.
Limit Playwright inspection to 30 seconds end to end with a 35-second outer tool deadline.
Replace generic 90-second Playwright stalls with actionable browser-step evidence.
Preserve native plugin approvals, citation curation, activity ordering, and Developer Mode isolation.
validation: Browser-only routing and backend/API exclusion regression coverage
Inspection step, 30-second inner deadline, 35-second outer deadline, and bounded evidence coverage
Release and Workshop Memory synchronization metadata validation
